title: Change in Aims Apac Reit Management Limited's position in AIMS APAC REIT
body: Aims Apac Reit Management Limited executed a transaction for 275,758 shares of AIMS APAC REIT. This increases their holdings from 10,299,164 to 10,574,922 shares.
reasons: Calculated price (transaction_value/amount_transaction=275758.00) does not match reported price_per_share=1.5536
Inconsistent total value: expected 428417.63 (amount_transaction * price_per_share), but got 76042474564.00
